tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bdud rtsi 'byung ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos gzhi lnga dang brda lnga dang*// kha ba tsha ba rdo rjer dbul ba dang*// a ka ru gnag kye'i rdo rje la sogs pa phyogs phyogs su bkod nas/ bgegs/ sdig pa/ dri ma rnams sbyangs nas/ swa bhā was stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/ so so'i sa bon las so so bskyed nas so so'i rigs dang mthun pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ gzugs sbyong zhing sku'i dngos grub ster ba'i ngo bor dmigs te/ oṃ āḥgo hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ la sogs pa brjod/ na dang ga ha dang po dang*// dang po'i shwa dang gang gi mthar// sha lnga rnal 'byor pa yis bza'// 'di dag sha lnga'i mchog yin te// rgyal ba yab lnga'i ngo bo nyid// dngos grub rgya mtsho 'gugs byed pa'i// lcags kyu rnam pa lnga yang yin// rigs dang dngos grub gsal ba yi// sgron ma lnga yang 'di yin no// oṃ āḥm hā pañtsa maṃ sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod do// de bzhin du sa bon las rnam par snang mdzad/ gti mug sbyong zhing me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du dmigs la/ oṃ āḥbi hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa brjod nas/ mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa 'di/ 'di lnga bdud rtsi'i mchog yin te// rgyal ba yum lnga'i ngo bo nyid// 'chi med tshe dang mchog stsol bas// bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga yin no// oṃ āḥm hā pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas rdzas gzhan rnams kyang de nyid gsum las bskyed pa las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i tshogs la thim par bsam zhing de nyid gsum byin gyis brlab bo// gong bu byin gyis brlab pa'i skabs te dang po'o// //rdo rje pad+ma rang bzhin gyis// rten dang gtun gyi rab sbyangs pa// snod gcig blugs nas ji bzhin du// bskyed nas sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab// khyad par yang ni 'di yin no// oṃ āḥgo go ru maṃ sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ āḥku ku ku ra maṃ sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥd da ta maṃ sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥha ha sti maṃ sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥn na ra maṃ sa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥbi re a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥrak+ta a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥshu kra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥm hā maṃ sa a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥmu tra a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sa bon so so'i ye shes kyang*// so sor bskyed cing byin brlabs nas// oṃ āḥbh+rūm̐ ā dar+sha dz+nyān a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.āṃ sa ma tā dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥdz+rī pra t+ya be k+ṣa dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ kri t+ya a nuṣ+ṭhā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rnams so// phyi ma byin rlabs kyi skabs te gnyis pa'o// //myos byed tsha ba nying khu ru// byas pa la sogs lde gur bya// yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas ni// sngar bzhin byin gyis brlab par bya// lde gu byin gyis brlab pa'i skabs te gsum pa'o// //de nas ril bur byas la sngar bzhin bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ gyi byin gyis brlabs pa yis// kha dog phun sum tshogs gyur cing*// sku yi rdo rje spyan drangs nas// rnal 'byor lus kyi dngos grub 'gyur// āḥyi byin gyis brlabs pa yis// phun sum tshogs pa'i ror ldan zhing*// gsung gi rdo rje spyan drangs nas// rnal 'byor ngag gi dngos grub 'gyur// hūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs pa yis// nus pa phun sum tshogs gyur cing*// thugs kyi rdo rje spyan drangs nas// rnal 'byor sems kyi dngos grub 'gyur// ha yis kha dog 'phrog par byed// phrogs nas 'phags pa mchod byed cing*// sems can thams cad tshim byed pa'i// kha dog dam par byin gyis brlabs// ha ha ha/

hos ni dri ni 'jig par byed// bshig nas 'phags pa mchod byed cing*// sems can thams cad tshim byed pa'i// nus mchog ldan par byin gyis brlab// hoḥhoḥhoḥhoḥ hrīḥs ni nus pa 'jig par byed// bshig nas 'phags pa mchod byed cing*// sems can thams cad tshim byed pa'i// nus mchog ldan par byin gyis brlab// hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ de nas tshe bsgrub pa'i phyir tshe dpag med yab yum gyi 'dus sbyor las byung ba'i bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ sngags so so'i mthar/ ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ puṇ+ye'i bzlas pa mang du bya'o// thog mar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya// rdzogs nas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya// phud kyis mchod nas slar yang ni// zhi bas lhag chad nyes pa sbyang*// bdud rtsi 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
